content: Echekhi ch'ẹkhaam ẹkhọkha ch'ọkpakkọrikkọ

K'ogbe kw'iwa Abram on-ode cho arọbh anna obhiri ọhawani kw'ẹrọbh, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oyin Abram abẹ, oben-ẹ bi, “Kaam wọ nde Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ẹfa biphyir, kọ hok aphaangi paam, abira aruk akpen p'atzor-otzor.
Kaam ńsi mach'iwa nkk'nchekhi nnang-ọ bi, va pa va pọ, ikhina bẹ áhaabh-ọhaabh.”
Mada Abram ọbhaang idik nna, ọrakha ottima itzitzikha k'irerek. Mẹ wọ, Ibinọkpaabyi oben-ẹ bi,
“Ma wọ ode odik kwa kaam nchekhi nnang-ọ: kọ áde otte kwa ngọma haabhada.
Kaam mbiri ńnang-ọ che ẹbhachẹ, Abram dọk kàkpena, kọ án-akpena Abraham, kw'oyini otte kw'idibhon k'ọhaabh.
Kaam ńsọ-ọ abhon va k'ọhaabh, ngọma sa nhaabh-ọhaabh ḿfona ma kọ, ọmaana avaar p'ideden.
Kaam ńsi echekhi nda cha kaam ttara kọ ebire ede echekhi cha va pa va pọ, k'igbọ s'ikwu k'ogbe ororo m'ipemanitzor. Kaam ńde Ibinọkpaabyi kwọ, ọmaana Ibinọkpaabyi kwa va pa va pọ.
Kaam ńdọkha irek sa Kenaan biphyir sa kọ arukhi mach'okhekhennọng madẹdẹn nnang kọ, ọmaana efona chọ, bọng akhaama sẹ m'ipemanitzor. Kaam wọ ńde Ibinọkpaabyi kwabẹ.”
Mẹ wọ, Ibinọkpaabyi oben Abraham bi, “Onode kọ, akhaambi ahok echekhi nda chaam, kọ ọmaana va pa va ttara igbọ s'ikwu k'ogbe ororo.
Ma wọ ode echekhi cha kaam ttara kọ, ọmaana va pa va pọ, echekhi cha bọng áhok ede bi, ojinọng kpenamkpen kw'owobh ttara bọng ósi ọkpakkọrikkọ.
Bọng ási ọkpakkọrikkọ kw'ẹkpakpa, kw'óde ẹkhọhkha ch'Echekhi cha kaam ttara bọng.

K'igbọ s'íkwu k'ororo, ijinọnọnga kpenamkpen kw'ode iwu izenanttaan, bẹ akhaambi asẹ-ẹ ọkpakkọrikkọ. Ajinọng biphyir, p'amaan ka bọng k'ọhọhm, ọmaana ayok pa bọng adebhi k'agbukha p'ani va pa bọng ade, bẹ akhaambi asi ọkpakkọrikkọ.
Kaambi p'amaan kabọng k'ihọhm bọ, obiro ode pa bọng adebhi k'agbukha o, bọng akhaambi, asi bẹ ọkpakkọrikkọ. Mando wọ kw'echekhi chaam ch'éde ebhora ka bọng ka for, éde echekhi ch'ipemanitzor.
Ojinọng kpenamkpen kw'oni ọkpakkọrikkọ kw'ẹkpakpa osi, bọng kọm-ẹ ẹkhaan, okhuri bi, kẹ okk'echekhi chaam obhuma ohohok.”
Echekhi ch'ẹmmaana ch'Isaak
Ibinọkpaabyi obiro oben Abraham bi, “Onode kwanọng kwọ, Sarai, kẹ Sarai dọk kokpena, kẹ ón-okpena Sara.
Kaam ńdẹ-ẹ, mbiri ńsẹ-ẹ ọmaan-ọ nnwa kw'ijinọng. Kaam ńdo Sara bi, óde ọkka kwa ngọma sa nhaabh-ọhaabh. Avaar p'ideden ábira afona ka ndaak sẹ.”

Mẹ wọ, Abraham otto okhubha itzitzikha sẹ m'irerek, ọnang Ibinọkpaabyi ikpokpobha, ọmma aha k'ettem oben bi, “Na ọnọng kw'on-ode cho arọbh azen macha kaam, obiro obhon nnwa o? Na Sara, kw'on-obiro ode cho arọbh anna obhiri jobh, obiro ọfha ọmaan nnwa dọkh o?”
Mẹ wọ, Abraham oben Ibinọkpaabyi bi, “Ira ode bi na ọdaakh-ọ, ira Ishimayẹl oruk ttara ẹdaa chọ.”

Mẹ wọ, Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, “Mma e! Sara kw'ode kwanọng kwọ, wọ ọ́maan nnwa kw'ijinọng ọnang-ọ. Kọ ákpẹ-ẹ Isaak. Kaam ńttima echekhi chaam ttara kẹ aranga. Éde echekhi ch'ewobha ẹnang va pa va pẹ, m'ipemanitzor.

Onode odik kw'okhuri Ishimayẹl, kaam nkk'ọ mmaanga e, k'odik-ọkka kaam ńdẹ-ẹ odo e, kaam ńsẹ-ẹ obhon va, mbiri nttaar-ẹ ọhaabh. Kẹ óbhon avaar-va jobh obhiri afa. Kaam ḿbiri nsẹ-ẹ ode ẹkhọma ch'ideden.
Yina, kaam ńgaama echekhi chaam ttara Isaak, kwa Sara ọ́maan ọnang-ọ ikhina cho nnamanda.”
Mada Ibinọkpaabyi okk'odik nwa ọgbaakha okyera, ofona oji Abraham mẹ.

M'ewu nduma dani, Abraham osi mach'Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹ ọgbaakha bi, osi. Ọtzọkha nnwa kwẹ Ishimayẹl, ọmaana ajinọng biphyir p'amaan m'ọhọhm kwẹ, ttara ayok p'odebhi k'agbukha, ojinọng kpenamkpen k'ọhọhm kwẹ, osi ọkpakkọrikkọ kw'ẹkpakpa.
Wa Abraham ode cho arọbh anna obhiri ọhawani kw'ẹrọbh, k'ogbe kwa bẹ asẹ-ẹ ọkpakkọrikkọ.
Nnwa kwẹ, Ishimayẹl, ode cho jobh obhiri attaan, mada bẹ asẹ-ẹ ọkpakkọrikkọ.
Wa bẹ asi Abraham ọmaana nnwa kwẹ Ishimayẹl ọkpakkọrikkọ, m'ewu nduma dani.
Wa Abraham ọmaana ojinọng kpenamkpen kw'owobh k'ọhọhm kwẹ, ọmaana ayok p'amaan m'ọhọhm kwẹ, ttara ayok p'odebhi k'agbukha ka mbọhk s'okhekhennọng, bẹ abira asi bẹ ọkpakkọrikkọ.
